security_observation: A caller-supplied authenticated-email header reaches the local Worker and is visibly marked as failure. This is expected local behavior and is not hosted anti-spoof evidence.
limitation: This validates the ordinary local browser journey only. It does not substitute for OpenAI Sites hosting or a supported ChatGPT Site-tools call.
